experiments.title: Rank README optimization methods by historical deltas
experiments.hypothesis: README record-history deltas provide a useful prior for the top 10 most effective optimization methods before expensive ablations.

experiments.title: Prepare optional 8xH200 node .75 pod
experiments.hypothesis: Node .75 has 8 free GPUs and can mount /data/develop/modded-nanogpt with the required runtime and data for top10 ablation experiments.
experiments.check: kubectl get pod modded-nanogpt-repro-75 -o jsonpath='{.status.phase}' | grep -q Running

experiments.title: Ablate Learnable XSA
experiments.hypothesis: Disabling Learnable XSA will worsen loss or speed enough to estimate its current-code contribution relative to README top10 candidates.

experiments.title: Ablate Bigram hash embedding
experiments.hypothesis: Disabling the bigram hash embedding will expose whether the recent historical speedup still has a large causal contribution in the current root.

experiments.title: Ablate value embeddings
experiments.hypothesis: Disabling value embeddings will estimate the current contribution of the README value-embedding family, including later value-gate tuning.

experiments.title: Ablate multi-token prediction
experiments.hypothesis: Turning MTP weights into single-token prediction should quantify whether MTP remains a top current-code contributor.

experiments.title: Ablate smear one-token lookback
experiments.hypothesis: Disabling smear isolates a small but cheap architecture feature that may or may not remain top10 in the current root.

experiments.title: Ablate Partial Key Offset
experiments.hypothesis: Disabling partial key offset will quantify whether this late README optimization remains a strong contributor in the current root.
